strategyFamily: six-sleeve diversified spot-perpetual funding and basis carry with venue-native conservative friction
motivation: Freeze a broader cross-asset replication of the simple fully collateralized carry mechanism before observing Trial 20 real LTC/TRX economics. Diversification is specified prospectively to test whether funding carry is a broad cross-asset premium rather than an artifact of one or two symbols. The fee model is inherited unchanged from the already-frozen Trial 20 venue-native assumption, not selected from Trial 21 outcomes.

assetSelection.rule: Select six longstanding liquid members of the previously frozen identity-clean 2022 liquidity universe that are not used by Trials 17-20 and whose Trial 21 funding/perpetual/basis histories have not been queried before freeze. Preserve the listed order; no post-result substitution is allowed.

portfolio.entryRule: Enter every sleeve once at the first exact 8-hour funding boundary in the evaluation window; no funding-sign, basis-sign, or price forecast filter.
portfolio.exitRule: Exit every sleeve at the final exact 8-hour funding boundary strictly before window end.
portfolio.position: long spot and short exactly equal coin units of the matching Binance USD-M perpetual

costModel.inheritance: Frozen before Trial 21 data by direct inheritance from Trial 20; no Trial 21 outcome informed these values.

finalHoldout.accessRule: No Trial 21 final derivative/funding row may be acquired unless the frozen development gate passes.

dataRequirements.spot: checksum-verified Binance Vision DAILY spot 8h klines
dataRequirements.perpetualExecution: checksum-verified Binance Vision MONTHLY USD-M standard 8h klines
dataRequirements.perpetualMark: checksum-verified union of MONTHLY and DAILY USD-M 8h markPriceKlines; exact overlap agreement required
dataRequirements.funding: checksum-verified Binance Vision MONTHLY USD-M fundingRate archives

developmentGate.decision: Every criterion must pass before final-holdout acquisition. Failure freezes Trial 21 without final access or in-place rescue.

promotionCriteria.decision: Every criterion must pass. Passing authorizes a separate paper-baseline promotion proposal only; never real-money trading.

antiRescueRule: After the first Trial 21 development economic output, no asset, sleeve weight, collateral, sizing, date, cost, source rule, entry/exit rule, development gate, final gate, or stress may change under Trial 21.
